title: Juix Resources (mod version)
description: Mod enabling Juix datapacks' custom textures
body:
# ℹ️ Juix Resources Juix Resources allows you to integrate custom textures for a large number of my datapacks, which depend on it (or it is highly recommended to use it)

When you download one of my datapacks, always make sure you have the latest version of Juix Resources to ensure support for custom textures. The minimum supported version of Juix Resources is always specified in the datapack description

![Custom Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c420554942819464de3b7ad1394d039a738cbbd.webp) # 🔄️ Resourcepack version You can download the [resourcepack version](https://modrinth.com/mod/juix-resources) if you prefer. This mod has the same effect as the resource pack and is only intended for use with datapacks (my modded versions of my datapacks already include the custom textures). You can install all my datapacks on the server side and share this resource pack (or this modded version) with your friends so they can get the textures for the added items.
# 🪳 Report a bug You can **report a bug** using one of these contact methods : - Quick message - https://juixcode.github.io/contact - My mail - juixcontact@gmail.com - The Discord server - clikc-here-to-join
